title: Caribbean islands, Bahamas and adjoining coasts
scope: Broad rectangular coverage includes the Greater and Lesser Antilles, Puerto Rico, USVI, BVI, Sint Maarten/Saint-Martin, Bahamas, Turks and Caicos, Cayman Islands, Aruba, Curacao, Bonaire and Trinidad and Tobago, plus adjoining mainland/coastal areas. Not nautical charts or routing.
